about: Cargo layouts per vehicle record (rp_cargo, row A9). Offsets are metres in the VEHICLE frame of Open77.props.attach with a root binding: +x right, +y forward (towards the cab), +z up; yaw in degrees around z. Every number below is a STARTING GUESS (measured: false) until the integrator has measured it in game with the lab commands (cargospawn / cargotune / cargolayout) on both clients. Paste the JSON that `cargolayout <vehicleId>` prints over the matching entry, then set measured to true for the slots you checked by eye.

Vehicle.v_standard3_thorton_mackinaw_pla.label: Thorton Mackinaw bed
Vehicle.v_standard3_thorton_mackinaw_pla.basis: Verified 2026-10-12 by the integrator on two clients (side and rear views, crate.small, two layers): the rp_nomade starting slots sit in the bed and stack cleanly; a drive was not tested. Origin: rp_nomade/shared/config.lua Truck.bed (2026-09-18): bed behind the cab, x in [-0.6, 0.6], y in [-2.6, -1.0], z ~0.9, labelled 'starting guesses, not measurements'

Vehicle.v_standard3_thorton_mackinaw_02_.label: Thorton Mackinaw 02 bed
Vehicle.v_standard3_thorton_mackinaw_02_.basis: Copied from the Mackinaw guesses (rp_nomade uses one bed for all three trucks). This record has a DIFFERENT entity template from Vehicle.v_standard3_thorton_mackinaw_player (docs/vehicle-models.md), so the bed may not match: measure it separately.

Vehicle.v_utility4_chevalier_legatus_pla.label: Chevalier Legatus cargo bed
Vehicle.v_utility4_chevalier_legatus_pla.basis: Copied from the Mackinaw guesses: rp_nomade applies the same four bed slots to the Legatus (class utility4, 'Truck'), whose body is larger. Expect every offset to move once measured; a wider layout may need more slots.

Vehicle.v_standard25_thorton_colby_picku.label: Thorton Colby pickup bed
Vehicle.v_standard25_thorton_colby_picku.basis: Starting guess by analogy with the Mackinaw bed for a smaller pickup (class standard25 'Pickup', docs/vehicle-models.md); no source measured it. Vehicle.v_standard25_thorton_colby_pickup_02_player shares the entity template, hence the alias.
